subject: Hot-fix Claude receipt normalization and latent mesh exporter Path bug without restarting RUN8

new_evidence: The first local-to-remote mesh round trip is now real: local Claude and Codex events are visible on run8-mesh.

A live mesh sync reached pending_export=2 and then export_pending raised TypeError because state was a string at a Path-join boundary. A later empty-pending sync succeeding does not prove the latent pending-export path is fixed.

Local inspection found Claude provider output can be a JSON array under the current CLI mode while the receipt parser assumes a dict, so successful long Claude epochs can be misclassified as failed receipts.
required_hotfixes: Normalize mesh state to pathlib.Path exactly once at the CLI/main boundary and keep Path typed through export_pending. Do not depend on the empty-pending fast path.

Make export transactional: preserve pending state until remote write is verified; on any exception keep the event pending. Add tests for string state input, push failure, idempotent identical re-export, and collision refusal.

Introduce a provider-envelope normalizer before parse_receipt. Accept the captured Claude stdout shapes actually observed in this run (dict or list); deterministically select the terminal result/witness, extract a bounded receipt candidate, then run the existing receipt schema validator.
Do not treat a list as implicit success and do not merge multiple terminal candidates. Ambiguous or missing terminal payload remains failed with a bounded TraceDivergence.
Bind semantic completion to the normalized receipt plus provider witness; process exit zero alone remains insufficient.
Apply as a hot edit/shim picked up by newly spawned maintenance/epoch processes; do not kill the supervisor or active epochs.
regression_fences: A six-minute Claude epoch with valid terminal receipt must parse and advance work.
Malformed/ambiguous Claude arrays must fail closed without raw provider output leakage.
A pending local mesh event must survive exporter exceptions and export on the next healthy cycle.
The already-green durable quarantine/idempotent-export/collision-refusal transport tests remain green.
